verdict.rationale: 2FAS documents letting users decide where data lives: their own cloud (iCloud/Google Drive), an encrypted file on an external drive, or self-hosting. Community discussion confirms WebDAV and local-file backup options, which gives user-controlled storage location by design. However, there is no explicit geographic region or residency selection; residency depends on whichever cloud or host the user picks. Missing for 10: explicit region/data-residency controls, documentation of where any 2FAS-operated sync or share data resides, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: You decide where to store your Items. You can store it in your own cloud or keep it as an encrypted file on an external drive.
You can enable secure data syncing with your personal iCloud or Google Drive
none of your Items are stored permanently in the browser's memory or on third-party servers
